composed_callee_effects: All direct game callees identified in the call map are EXACT_NATURAL manifest claims. In particular f_24AB_038D is an exact 127-byte function that writes g_3DA0 on empty/active-font paths, calls exact f_1FBD_0000 or exact font_MakeImage, and forwards exact bitmap/coordinates through the same current g_9154 callback pointer.

f_1FBD_0000 and its f_1B4E routines are exact claims; font_MakeImage, _font_StringWidth, _font_CharWidth, and f_2650 routines are exact claims. The dynamic g_9154 pointer is read from the same entry state and passed the same arguments; its value is not written by the target or helper.
Punt and WinPrintf have exact source claims. Far _fstrlen/_fstrncpy/_fstrcpy/_fstrcmp resolve to the pinned verified large-model aliases of accepted MSC runtime members.
pointer_contents: Both draw-helper calls receive x,y and local buf. Before each call buf is populated from the same text slice and explicitly NUL-terminated; the first call has only a read-only WinPrintf between copy and draw, the final call follows its copy directly. Exact helper code consumes pointed string contents and does not retain/compare the caller buffer address.
Style/table/rectangle pointers are dereferenced at the mapped offsets; source inputs and table contents are pinned, and the recorded run reports peer_data_gates=PASS.
memory_state_effects.return_abi: void far; restores BP/SI/DI and far-returns; caller removes arguments; no semantic return value

algorithm_and_cfg.evidence: All 48 conditional sites and 21 unconditional edges are mapped. Source lines 129-237 account for initialization, font selection, outer line loop, style transition and output, per-character advance and punctuation switch, clipping, final draw, whitespace/newline handling and exit.

conditions_constants_width_signedness.evidence: Each branch record states source predicate, operand width and signedness. Model: 16-bit signed int, 16-bit unsigned int, 32-bit signed long, signed char, 16:16 far pointers. Constants 0x100, 110, 0x7d, punctuation bytes, LF/CR/space, and zero sentinels are mapped.

pointer_arithmetic_and_layout.evidence: Far text/styl/rect pointer offsets, count-word styl+1, 20-byte StyleRun stride with signed-long pos/face offset 10, 34-byte TextRez stride/id offset 32, 10-byte HotSpot stride, signed _ctype indexing, and target-word arithmetic are accounted for.

calls_abi_and_order.evidence: All 18 source calls and the generated stack-check call are mapped with dynamic repetition/conditions, arguments, far/cdecl ABI and caller cleanup. The conditional second f_24AB_030B call at 0112 is preserved.

direct_memory_and_state.evidence: Direct nonstack writes are only g_8C24 and successful HotSpot fields; local buf mutation and all reads are inventoried.

callee_composition.dynamic_callback: g_9154 is an indirect call through the same input-state pointer; exact helper code forwards the same x/y/bitmap/width/height arguments and no code in the audited caller changes that pointer.

table_data.evidence: Registered whole module source contains the TextRez initializer; primary behavioral run reports peer_data_gates=PASS. The source module hash and run pin are recorded.

effective_8086_extension_widths.evidence: At 0125 and 01BF the one-byte extension opcodes have no operand-size override, so use 8086 CWD (AX sign-extends to DX:AX); at 029F, 03A3 and 03BF use 8086 CBW (AL sign-extends to AX). Capstone labels shown by context (cdq/cwde) are decoder aliases and not the effective 16-bit operation.

function_boundary.evidence: Original extent S23:39C7:0092, 1,039 bytes; the source definition is lines 108-238; context identifies retf at 04A0 and exclusive end 04A1.

remaining_differences.description: 8086 BP frame, stack check, local allocation, SI/DI saves and far epilogue are compiler ABI/frame emissions; the source algorithm and far return match.
MSC lowers one signed 32-bit StyleRun.pos <= (long)pos predicate into signed high-word and unsigned low-word branches; all stages map to the same source predicate.
MSC lowers switch labels to a byte-subtract decision chain and range guard; every case assigns the source brk/done result and default leaves brk unchanged.
